purpose: Identify the real vendor DS4 MoE execution path under a strict 16GB cgroup and test whether MXFP4/F8 can use the existing single-expert CUDA stream path.

common_config.prompt: Please introduce France in a short paragraph.

diagnostic_changes: GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_TRACE_OUT records single-expert CUDA stream activity when that path is actually used.
GGML_MOE_CPU_CHUNK_TRACE_OUT records CPU fallback chunk timing per tensor/expert/thread.

cuda_one_trace_case.interpretation: The DS4 model did not enter the effective ggml_cuda_moe_stream_one path; it falls back to CPU expert compute for MXFP4/F8 tensors.

cpu_chunk_trace_case.top_observation: The slowest chunks were in blk.0.ffn_up_exps.weight, especially experts 47 and 75, with single chunks up to about 1053 ms.

rejected_mxfp4_f8_stream_gate_case.attempted_change: Allow ggml_cuda_moe_stream_one to accept GGML_TYPE_MXFP4 and GGML_TYPE_F8_E4M3_B128 in addition to GGML_TYPE_IQ3_XXS.
rejected_mxfp4_f8_stream_gate_case.stderr_evidence: [moe_stream] first call: ne01=2048 ne00=4096 nb01=2176 src0_bytes=4456448 cne1=2
rejected_mxfp4_f8_stream_gate_case.action: Stopped the run and reverted the type-gate change.
rejected_mxfp4_f8_stream_gate_case.conclusion: A type-gate-only MXFP4/F8 stream change is incorrect; the DS4 stream path needs a proper layout/kernel calling convention fix before it can be considered again.

next_steps: Compare moe_stream_one against the working CUDA mmvq path for MXFP4/F8 and implement a correctness-first DS4 stream path.
Use CPU chunk trace to guide cold-page prefetch or selective residency if the CUDA stream path remains blocked.
